name: Bark River
blurb: Bark River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: From the County Highway E access area through Rome Pond to Highway 106. A land carry around Rome Dam is required. Markers show approximate facilities, not the carry or exact shoreline. The 12.5-mile planning distance is preliminary; check access, water levels and the carry before launching.
sections.routeReview: The county guide documents a carry from Rome Feed Mill Park to the downstream launch near Picket’s. No exact carry or continuous dotted path across Rome Dam is mapped.

notices.title: Rome Dam: portage required
notices.text: The county guide directs paddlers to leave the pond at Rome Feed Mill Park, on the south bank east of the dam, and carry to the launch south of Highway F near Picket’s. Confirm the signed carry during your shuttle; do not paddle through the dam.
notices.sourceName: Jefferson County — Water Trails Guide, sites 43–44

notices.title: Former dams: watch for debris
notices.text: County maps warn of debris at former Slabtown Dam. The DNR inventory lists Slabtown and Cushman as removed; removal does not mean the channel is clear. Check current conditions and avoid approaching obstructions.
notices.sourceName: Jefferson County — Bark River segment maps and Wisconsin DNR dam inventory

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.routeReview: The county guide warns of Hebron dam remnants downstream of Highway 106 and calls for a carry. Locate the signed take-out and confirm the usable carry before launching. No continuous dotted path or exact portage is mapped.

notices.title: Hebron dam remnants: carry required
notices.text: The county guide calls for a carry around old dam remnants before Green Isle Street Bridge. Its segment map also warns of debris. Confirm the take-out and current carry with the county before launching; the access map does not establish a route across private land.
notices.sourceName: Jefferson County — Water Trails Guide, site 46 and Bark River segment 2

sections.takeOut: Burnt Village County Park Boat Ramp

sections.routeReview: The dotted line is a river-course overview between approximate access areas. It follows river bends without mapping exact shoreline connections or a navigable line. Planning distance and timing remain separate from this display.
